subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into the current sub-agent guidance surfaces, or paused because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The remaining blocker is maintainer intent for model-facing prompt policy and nested-spawn semantics, not a narrow mechanical repair that automation should choose for a protected maintainer-labeled PR.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only the useful examples into current availability- and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, change runtime depth behavior, config schema/help, docs, and tests in the same direction.

options.title: Pause As Covered
options.body: If current main guidance is enough, leave or close this protected branch by maintainer decision without carrying the stale prompt rubric forward.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only the useful examples into current availability- and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged prompt/orchestration work is the clearest current-main owner signal for this model-facing policy choice.
